scope: Check set for memory recall, written on 2026-11-24 after the recency delta (0.03) was fixed on evals/memory/questions.json and before this set was run. Not to be used for tuning. The first 8 ask for facts that changed over time (an older version is also in the notes); the other 12 are general. `gold` is a verbatim phrase from the note that answers. After its one run, 4 questions gained an `also` phrase where a returned note answered in other words (label fix, no method change); strict scores are reported too.
